subject.title: docs: map the algorithmic closure system

question: After rebasing onto current main, are the guide’s rollout-status and authorization boundaries accurate enough to publish as ClawSweeper’s canonical architecture reference?
rationale: The document covers transient multi-PR rollout state and mutation authority; only maintainers with context on the landing sequence can confirm those claims are stable and intentional.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Rebase, update the rollout table and affected claims, then merge after an area-owner accuracy pass.

options.title: Wait for rollout completion
options.body: Keep the draft open until the dependent implementation stack stabilizes, then refresh the document once against the final state.

options.title: Document stable behavior only
options.body: Remove forward-looking rollout material and publish only behavior already verifiable on current main.

recommendation.title: Approve after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase, update the rollout table and affected claims, then merge after an area-owner accuracy pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member authored and iterated the complete architecture document and is best positioned to reconcile it with the intended rollout.
